items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: used to tell McGuire, Miranda (inaudible) all there

ctx.x: of those numbers have that problem, because they -- the -- the percussionists, they're limited because there's no clave field. You don't get that spreading over two bars.

See, I'm glad you brought that up. That's where Chano Pozo (inaudible) used to try (inaudible). And I'm glad you brought that up because, before Chano got here, Machito Mangual and the whole band Majici used to tell McGuire, Miranda (inaudible) all there, (inaudible) and the conga, that they didn't know nothing about this, and Chano's ways (inaudible). They say, no, but (inaudible) Chano he's nothing like you're talking about. And people said Machito time would tell.
So when Chano got here, we went to recording A Bongo Session (inaudible) with Miguelito, for Sanger SMC or CMS.
